rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something visually striking and attention-grabbing.

example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 sai1 zong1 zan1 hai6 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this for a stylish, expensive-looking person or thing that has an impressive air.

example.english: Dressed like that, they look really flash.
example.traditional: 佢着成咁，睇落好有派頭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 seng4 gam3 tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 paai3 tau4

rows.note: Use this when the flashy style seems exaggerated or deliberately over-the-top.

example.english: The colour of their new car is too flash.
example.traditional: 佢部新車個車身顏色太浮誇喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bou6 san1 ce1 go3 ce1 san1 ngaan4 sik1 taai3 fau4 kwaa1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone or something conspicuously attracts attention in an ostentatious way.

example.english: They drive their sports car around town, being flash.
example.traditional: 佢揸住架跑車周街招搖。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zaa1 zyu6 gaa3 paau2 ce1 zau1 gaai1 ziu1 jiu4

rows.note: For a light that blinks or flashes on and off, 閃 is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: I see the lamp flash on and off, making my eyes go blurry.
example.traditional: 盞燈閃吓閃吓，搞到我眼都花。
example.jyutping: zaan2 dang1 sim2 haa5 sim2 haa5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 faa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a sudden burst of light.

example.english: The camera's flash was so bright that I couldn't keep my eyes open.
example.traditional: 相機嘅閃光照到我睜唔開眼。
example.jyutping: soeng1 gei1 ge3 sim2 gwong1 ziu3 dou2 ngo5 zaang1 m4 hoi1 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this specifically for a handheld electric torch or flashlight.

example.english: It's pitch-dark, and I can't find the flash.
example.jyutping: hak1 maa4 maa4 ngo5 wan2 m4 dou2 din6 tung2

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately shines a light briefly at something.

example.english: I flash my torch briefly at the address plaque so I can read it clearly.
example.traditional: 我拎電筒照一照個門牌，先睇清楚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ling1 din6 tung2 ziu3 jat1 ziu3 go3 mun4 paai4 sin1 tai2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for a period as short as the time it takes to blink.

example.english: In a flash, they were already gone.
example.jyutping: jat1 zaam2 ngaan5 keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2

rows.note: Use this when scenery or another visible thing passes by so quickly that it is seen only briefly.

example.english: I saw the car flash past me so quickly that I couldn't read its number plate.
example.traditional: 架車喺我面前一閃而過，我都睇唔清車牌。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 jat1 sim2 ji4 gwo3 ngo5 dou1 tai2 m4 cing1 ce1 paai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the accidental or deliberate public exposure of underwear or an intimate body part.

example.english: They can accidentally flash their underwear when they sit down.
example.traditional: 佢坐低嗰陣唔小心走光。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zo6 dai1 go2 zan6 m4 siu2 sam1 zau2 gwong1

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone accidentally or momentarily exposes intimate body parts or underwear.

example.english: That skirt is so short—be careful, or you might flash your underwear when you sit down.
example.traditional: 條裙咁短，小心坐低會走光。
example.jyutping: tiu4 kwan4 gam3 dyun2 siu2 sam1 co5 dai1 wui5 zau2 gwong1
